title: Hinomori Shiho — Snacks In Hand〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Looks like Honami isn't here yet...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I guess I should send a message saying that I already am.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I wonder how Ichika and Saki are doing. I hope their songwriting is coming along okay...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: At the same time, there's sort of no point in worrying...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I'm glad I was able to find some good snacks. I'm sure they're going to enjoy these.
Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sorry to keep you waiting.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's okay. I also just got here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, you said you were going to make dinner for them. What did you bring?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Curry.
My hope was that something spicy would give them a nice boost of energy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, the store just happened to be having a sale on seafood, so I decided to throw in some squid and shrimp to make it extra filling...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds really good...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
What snacks did you bring, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I just stopped by that convenience store over there...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I bought chocolate cookies, biscuits, those chips Saki really likes, all kinds of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, look at that.
You got quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Are these yakisoba bun flavored...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I knew it had to be these the moment I saw them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Of course!
Ichika's going to be so surprised.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But how do you think they taste?
I might try some if she says they're okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too. I'm also a little curious.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I get how you make something yakisoba flavored, but I have no idea how you deal with the bun...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't know either.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, don't you wanna see Ichika's reaction?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehehe...
Do you think she'll actually say, “This tastes just like a yakisoba bun”...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'd probably start cracking up if I saw that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What kind of song do you think they're going to write...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I don't know.
I mean, it is their first time writing one together...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I can't say what kind of song they're going to produce... But I'm really looking forward to hearing it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What kind of song are you hoping for, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Me? Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A song with a cool bassline...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Also, my own solo.
That'd be fun to play during shows and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe...
It's so like you to say that, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'd also like it if it included some cool drum parts. Imagine if the intro began with a drum solo.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Actually, that's not a bad option. It'd leave a strong impression and sound really cool.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I'd be surprised if Saki and Ichika came up with that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehehe. True...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, jokes aside.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sure they'll come up with something really good for us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, let's maintain our faith and make sure we're ready to play at a moment's notice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. I agree.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, to make sure their song does turn out well, we should get our gifts to them as soon as we can.
